outside the shipped resource tree during production; only edited game-ready files are
included here.

## Sound Effects

All files in `sfx/` were edited from the public-domain
[RPG Sound Pack](https://opengameart.org/content/rpg-sound-pack) by artisticdude.
Edits include trimming, filtering, pitch/timing changes, mixing, mono conversion, and
loudness normalization. They remain available under CC0/public-domain terms.

Target format:

- Music: stereo OGG Vorbis, 44.1 kHz.
- Sound effects: mono 16-bit PCM WAV, 44.1 kHz.
- Music target: approximately -19 to -22 LUFS.
- Sound effect target: approximately -12 to -19 LUFS by cue importance.
